levels.surface: محمد بن الحسن بن أحمد بن الوليد

notes: «قال سمعت سلمان الفارسي» makes Salman the last link: he is the one whose account (present at the Prophet's last illness) is relayed.
«رضي الله عنه» and the other blessings are not part of the surfaces; the long saying contains no further chain.
